final: WITH rating_metrics AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) as avg_repl_cost, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) as daily_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(daily_price) as avg_daily FROM rating_metrics), filtered AS (SELECT avg_repl_cost, daily_price FROM rating_metrics rm CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE rm.daily_price > oa.avg_daily) SELECT AVG(avg_repl_cost) as avg_replacement_cost, AVG(daily_price) as avg_daily_price, AVG(daily_price - (SELECT avg_daily FROM overall_avg)) as avg_excess_over_mean FROM filtered
